Keep the scripted evidence boundary and lettering visible.", "lettering": [ { "box": [ 0.58, 0.04, 0.38, 0.36060000000000003 ] } ], "lettering_mode": "manual", "nodes": [ { "asset": "terminal", "box": [ 0.07, 0.2936, 0.07955, 0.348 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true, "label": "TERMINAL", "label_box": [ 0.062000000000000006, 0.6476, 0.09555, 0.085 ] }, { "asset": "card", "box": [ 0.1775, 0.2936, 0.07955, 0.348 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true, "label": "DIFF", "label_box": [ 0.16949999999999998, 0.6476, 0.09555, 0.085 ] }, { "asset": "checkmark", "box": [ 0.285, 0.4079375, 0.07955, 0.11932499999999999 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true, "label": "VALIDATION", "label_box": [ 0.27699999999999997, 0.6476, 0.09555, 0.085 ] }, { "asset": "card", "box": [ 0.3925, 0.2936, 0.07955, 0.348 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true, "label": "COMMIT", "label_box": [ 0.3845, 0.6476, 0.09555, 0.085 ] } ], "reconstructed": false, "shot": "row", "source": "
**Frame:** Curt adds a lane the diagram never had, and it does not look like the others.
No window, no chat, no reply. A terminal line, a diff, a validator's exit code, a commit
trailer. The register is the tooling surface, not a conversation.

**Action:** The apparatus acquires an author.

**Caption:**
> THE VALIDATORS. THE PAGE TOOL. THE CROSS REFERENCE. THE CHARACTER FILE THAT SAYS WHAT
> THIS PAGE MAY CLAIM.
>
> A SECOND MODEL WROTE THEM, UNDER A CONTRACT IT DID NOT WRITE.

**Provenance:** `documented` + `inferred` — co-authorship is recorded commit by commit in
the repository's Git history and in [`CREDITS.md`](../../CREDITS.md). That this is the
situation of every agent in the first half of the book is the project's observation and is
not drawn as one.

", "title": "A tooling lane adds terminal diff validation and commit" } }
